newsitem.title: USA: Rallying U.S. sweet crudes bolster domestic market.
newsitem.headline: Rallying U.S. sweet crudes bolster domestic market.

text.p: Prices for domestic sweet crude barrels bolstered U.S. cash crude markets Monday morning, staging a rally similar to the morning push higher on Friday morning, traders said.
Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James began the session at a nearly 20 cents discount to the May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing benchmark, but was last sold at only a 4 cts break to the marker.
"The North Sea is pretty clean (of barrels), so there is no sweet available and people need to buy," said a dealer.
Other domestic grades were hovering around steady prices.
